songs.title: Golden Gate
songs.lyrics:
We got married under the Golden Gate
Then we got drunk in the Upper Haight|It was a sunny day

'Til we left the city for a modest home|A Springsteen song

And when I die I'll see your face in a sun dress on a Saturday|And I just called to say
I know you're always sitting in the barrio waiting|I know that there will come a day
